data.title: 黍 · 阳台种菜也要教你一起做
data.description: 家中阳台菜箱前，黍穿鼠尾草绿亚麻衬衫与米白长裤，把刚摘的小番茄放在金色手心递给你看。她侧身笑着指向结实的枝条，像在教你判断熟没熟；龙尾沿菜箱外侧自然弯过，不碰枝叶。
data.action: 展示掌心小番茄，另一手指着枝条与你分享
data.lighting: 清晨左侧日光，栏杆与枝叶投影，柔和环境反光
data.promptProse: Shu presents one ripe cherry tomato on her golden palm and points out a fruiting branch with her other hand, smiling as she explains how to recognize a ripe fruit. Her shirt cuffs are rolled back, and her dragon tail curves outside the planter without touching its leaves. The home balcony continues behind her: its railing recedes in perspective, with neighboring residential facades visible beyond it and wooden floorboards leading into the space. Morning sunlight enters from the left and catches her hair, hands and the tomato. The railing and leaves cast defined shadows across her shirt, the planter and the floor; gentle reflected daylight keeps her shaded cheek readable, while the distant buildings have softer contrast.
